title: Hoofprints in the Snow
story: A week into the investigation, you find small hoofprints circling the vault's window, along with a few tufts of red felt caught on the frame. Everyone in the stables points to the same suspect: Jingle, the youngest reindeer calf, who's been sneaking out at night to "practice tricks" no one's allowed to watch.
question: In the poem 'A Visit from St. Nicholas' (better known as 'The Night Before Christmas'), which reindeer is named last in the original list, right after 'Donder'?
